{"id":1893675869,"question_id":4079,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"6 months","timestamp":1769110007,"status":11,"status_display":"Wrong Answer","runtime":"N/A","url":"/submissions/detail/1893675869/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Maximum Capacity Within Budget","memory":"N/A","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    int byBS(vector<pair<int,int>>&vp , int target , int idx)\n    {   \n        int s = 0;\n        int e = idx - 1;\n        int ans = -1;\n        while(s <= e)\n        {\n            int mid = s + (e-s)/2;\n            if(vp[mid].first < target)\n            {\n                ans = mid;\n                s = mid + 1;\n            }\n            else e = mid - 1;\n        }\n        return ans;\n    }\n\n    int maxCapacity(vector<int>& costs, vector<int>& capacity, int budget) {\n        int n = costs.size();\n        vector<pair<int,int>>vp;\n\n        for(int i = 0 ; i<n ; i++) vp.push_back({costs[i] , capacity[i]});\n        sort(vp.begin() , vp.end());\n\n        //max capacity can be of only one machine and hence initialized here..\n        int max_cap = INT_MIN;\n        for(int i = 0 ; i<vp.size() ; i++)\n        {\n            if(vp[i].first < budget)\n            {\n                max_cap = max(max_cap , vp[i].second);\n            }\n        }\n\n        for(int i = 0 ; i<vp.size() ; i++)\n        {\n            int second_machine_idx = byBS(vp , budget - vp[i].first , i);\n            if(second_machine_idx != -1) \n                max_cap = max(max_cap , (vp[second_machine_idx].second + vp[i].second)); \n        }\n        return max_cap;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"maximum-capacity-within-budget","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1533}
